result.quote: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice and their blood be avenged
result.reason: Verse 9:24 supports the stated purpose, but the window does not say that God caused the leaders to treat Abimelech deceitfully; that action and its connection to the purpose depend on missing context. The edit also changes the source’s “allowed” to “caused,” materially changing God’s role rather than preserving the original target.
